name: Corellian target-assist blaster defense turret
description: The Corellian target assist blaster defense turret was a variety of blaster cannon emplacement that was utilized by the Republic Military during the Great Galactic War. The turrets were used to great effect during the second Battle of Bothawui against the invading Imperial Army.
